depiction.primary_object: round analog clock face with two hands and four tick marks

readings.meaning: time tracking, working hours, or timesheet
schedule, opening hours, or time slot
daylight saving time or time zone adjustment

ambiguity: Very similar to simpler clock icons without tick marks; distinguished from wristwatch icons by the lack of a strap and from alarm clocks by the lack of bells.
task_intents: buy or hang a wall clock

reasoning: Shows a clear analog clock face with four quarter-hour tick marks and hands set to about 4:00. Best suited for tasks literally about household clocks, logging work hours/timesheets, opening hours, or time-zone adjustments, though it should not be overused for any task that merely has a due time.
